decision_target: Decide whether a larger local embedding or reranker earns a same-corpus development shadow; this program cannot qualify S1 or promote the current runtime.

hypothesis.primary: Qwen3 4B may improve same-pool financial hard-negative ordering and material target-in-pool stability versus Qwen3 0.6B without identity, period, role, or source regressions.
hypothesis.falsification: If the shared candidate pool lacks the material target, a larger reranker cannot repair the miss; if a larger model does not clear the preregistered material-gain and hard-safety gates, it is rejected.
hypothesis.known_cost_r2_diagnostic: Three useful COST candidates were already in the shared pool at rank 21, so model size is only a ranking challenger and may not replace request-bound material-group selection.

deferred.reason: multimodal visual-document capability and Qwen Research License require a separate VS2/license decision, not a same-text-corpus swap
older 7B candidate adds local resource burden before the 4B hypothesis is tested
English-focused 7B candidate is not the first multilingual financial challenger
8B resource and license constraints do not fit the first mainline challenger

fixed_instructions.embedding_query_instruction: Given a financial research evidence request, retrieve source-bound passages or objects that directly support, contradict, bridge, contextualize, or provide the required same-basis temporal comparison. Preserve company, metric, period, relationship direction, evidence role, and source identity.
fixed_instructions.reranker_instruction: Judge whether the document materially satisfies the financial evidence request. Prefer exact company, metric, period, relationship direction, source authority, evidence role, and same-basis temporal comparability; reject topic-only co-mentions and identity or period mismatches.

embedding_node.purpose: encode the unchanged development candidate corpus and request queries
embedding_node.input_scale: up to 34166 current compiled objects plus bounded DELL/MU/NVDA development requests
embedding_node.required_output: normalized dense vectors and content-addressed cache receipt
embedding_node.schema_burden: model identity, object digest, dimensions, truncation, device, precision, latency, and peak VRAM
embedding_node.materiality_quality_risk: company, metric, period, relation, and role misses can make downstream evidence incomplete
embedding_node.stop_and_truncation: fixed 512-token initial profile; record truncation; no silent object omission or CPU fallback

reranker_node.purpose: rerank only the identical bounded candidate pool after ceiling passes
reranker_node.input_scale: at most 96 candidates per bounded development request with batch size starting at one
reranker_node.required_output: yes/no relevance logits and deterministic ranks
reranker_node.schema_burden: pair identity, instruction digest, model digest, truncation, device, precision, latency, and peak VRAM
reranker_node.materiality_quality_risk: topic co-mentions can displace direct, counter, bridge, context, or temporal evidence
reranker_node.reasoning_profile: non-generative scored yes/no surface; free-form generation forbidden
reranker_node.stop_and_truncation: fixed 512-token initial profile; ceiling-first stop; no CPU, quantized, or hidden-label fallback
